rows.en: Zoffy?
Zoffy?
We Ultra Brothers will send our energy to you!
Join your strength together and save your own planet, Earth!
The Earth is beautiful… It is the star of hope for all of you humans! You must not lose it! You must not abandon it!

Now… stand up!

For the Earth… and for all of humanity…
Thank you, Ultra Brothers…
Thank you, Ultra Brothers…
Ku ku ku… You insects intend to stand against me?
Even insects have every right to live! I won't let you do as you please!
Even insects have every right to live! I won't let you do as you please!
Interesting… Then I shall take you on! Ha ha ha!

Nuooooh… Impossible… My… Fusion Steel… is… breaking… apart… Gboh… Gboh…

Gboh… Ngh… Zephas… your… final wish… Gboh… …the Earth… burned in crimson flames…!! Fuhahaha… Gboh… Ha ha ha…
The Earth burned in crimson flames…? What does that mean?

…!?

It's going to self-destruct…!
Damn it! What do I do? What do I…
[HERO4]…? Is it really you!?

"The explosion of the Space Fortress Naager can no longer be avoided!

But if you release your Fusion Steel… all of its energy, and create an energy field…

you should be able to send the shockwave of the explosion straight up into the sky!

Combined with the TDF's lead barrier, the effect on the surrounding area can be kept to a minimum!"
Got it, I'll try!
[HERO2]… What are you going to do?
I'll release my Fusion Steel and create an energy field! That's how I'll protect the Earth!!

Hold on! [HERO2], what will happen to you!?

[HERO4] said it too, didn't she? You've already atoned enough for your sins… There's no need to throw your life away!

Hongo…

I meant all my battles so far as atonement…

I've fought to atone for the evil I did as the Black Knight Lucifard…

But now I think… it was precisely because of those battles that I feel I got my true self back!

I thought I was doing good deeds, but in the end, I was the one who got taught. What it means to live as a human, and what life is all about…

It wasn't until [HERO4] was gone that I realized it!

So I'm… going to do what I can to protect this planet where I was born!
All right! I'm with you!
Me too…!
No… Please don't get in the way of what I have to do! This is my first and last request!
I'm begging you…!
[HERO2]…

You… Trying to look cool right to the end!

[HERO2]…

I'll never forget you! And I'm proud to have fought alongside a brave warrior called Lucifard.

Thank you! Rider 1… and Rider 2…

Now, go! There's no time left…
Don't you die…

Thank you, my friends…

Oyassan… I'm sorry I couldn't even say goodbye… Please, forgive me!

Fusion Steel, maximum output!! D-Field, full deployment!!
Fools… Your power amounts to no more than this! Ha ha ha…
Fools… Your power amounts to no more than this! Ha ha ha…
Fools… Your power amounts to no more than this! Ha ha ha…
Defeat all Gigants and EATERs!
Defeat Zephas!
Defeat Zephas Core!
Any member of the assault team is defeated

You had us worried!

These guys told me that [HERO4] got eaten by Atefarina…
I did get eaten! Really…
Yeah… It really gave me a shock!
I had a dream… I was talking with Atefarina.
With Atefarina…?
That's right… And she let me come back.
Geez… Same as always, I can't make heads or tails of what you're saying.

Maybe…

Atefarina, who fused with [HERO4], was also… sort of… fused with her on the level of consciousness, and that's how they talked…?
What a strange story, huh?
But… I'm really glad you made it back safely!
You seem a little more grown up, [HERO4]…

Oh… You can tell?

I thought so too…
Don't say it yourself! Grown up, my foot… All you ever do is make me worry!
Huh…? You were worried about me?
W-Well, kind of…
No way…!? Does that mean…?

Right now we can't afford to be short even one fighter…

Oyassan… I'm going to join Hongo and the others!

Yeah, I'm counting on you! Bring Takeshi and the others back safe!

[HERO4]… When they're back, let's have a party, okay?

And all of this… depends on him, doesn't it?

No matter how well the barrier protects us, if we can't save the Earth itself, it's all for nothing.
Ultra Garrison, moving out!!
So we just have to smash this thing, right?
But it doesn't look like it'll be that easy…
So that's Steel Emperor Zephas…!?

Heh heh heh… Welcome to my castle…!

I have prepared a welcoming banquet and waited for you!
What!?
A welcoming banquet?
Heh heh heh, this is a rare entertainment! I shall enjoy it thoroughly! I look forward to seeing how many of you remain.
I shall teach you in full what the bioweapons born from Fusion Steel are like!

…!?

Apfaron…!?

Our Fusion Steel is made of prokaryotic cells with cell-adhesion functions.

Those adhesion factors act to fuse it with the human body, which is made of eukaryotic cells, and the Fusion Steel is fully equipped!
It's worlds apart from the Vol's EATERs! Feel the power of the Fusion Steel! Here I come!

"So this is what it looks like clad in Fusion Steel?

What incredible killing intent! There isn't a single opening… Can we win? With just us…"
Without the dimensional distortion field, even a kid could get in here!
[HERO2] and the others are heading this way too!
Let's join forces and give it our all!!
But please be careful! We don't know what Apfaron's Fusion Steel is capable of!

I-Impossible… Fusion Steel, defeated!?

No… There's no way my Fusion Steel could lose…

But… destroying this space fortress is impossible… You will all… d-die… in despair… in the depths of despair…

Heh heh heh… Ha ha ha!!
[HERO4]!?
[HERO4]!?

U16061: 護て read as 全て ('Defeat all Gigants and EATERs!')
U16081: 'he/they' going to Hongo and others; 行って来ます = speaker [HERO2] goes
U16082: 猛 = Takeshi (Hongo) given name, rendered 'Takeshi'
